title: Personalised Care
description: Every skin and hair concern is different. We take the time to understand your needs and recommend a treatment approach suited to you, never a one-size-fits-all package.

title: Experienced Professionals
description: Treatments are planned by Dr. Daksha Patel, MBBS, MD (Skin & VD), with 17+ years in dermatology and cosmetology, and performed by trained professionals who stay updated with modern techniques.

title: Safety & Hygiene
description: Your safety comes first. We follow appropriate clinical hygiene and safety protocols and use quality equipment for every treatment, with your comfort and privacy protected.

title: Realistic Expectations
description: Clear and honest communication at every step. We explain what a treatment can and cannot do, how many sessions it takes and what downtime to expect, then support you with proper guidance and aftercare.
